_comment: Hand-curated look-alike sets for the Spot the Imposter game. `groups[].chars` is a plain string of characters — the first is not special. `tight` is 0-1: how hard the set is to tell apart, which drives the difficulty curve. `outside` carries pinyin/meaning for characters that are NOT in the HSK 1-3 dataset; those may only ever appear as distractors, never as the answer.

巳.meaning: sixth earthly branch; the snake hour

groups.note: Three strokes, three different mouths: 己 jǐ is wide open on the left, 已 yǐ is half closed, 巳 sì is sealed shut.
All are 木 with one extra bar. 本 běn marks the root at the *foot*; 末 mò marks the tip with a *long* stroke on top; 未 wèi uses a *short* one.
大 dà is a person with arms out. 天 tiān lays a flat sky above the arms, 夫 fū pushes a hairpin straight *through* them, 太 tài drops a dot underneath.
Same dot, different corner: 太 tài wears it low and centred, 犬 quǎn wears it high on the right shoulder.
Proportion is the only clue. 日 rì (sun) is taller than it is wide; 曰 yuē (to say) is wider than it is tall.
白 bái is 日 with a dropped stroke on top. 百 bǎi lays a full 一 above that. 自 zì is taller with an extra bar inside.
Where do the two strokes meet? 人 rén: the left stroke starts on top. 入 rù: the right one reaches *over* the left. 八 bā: they never touch at all.
A cross plus bars, five ways. 十 shí is the bare cross; 千 qiān adds a slanting flick; 干 gān has two full horizontals; 土 tǔ has the longer bar at the *bottom*; 士 shì has it on *top*.
刀 dāo is the bare blade. 力 lì bends the left stroke into a straining arm. 办 bàn is 力 flanked by two dots.
The tail decides it: 手 shǒu hooks *down* at the bottom, 毛 máo flicks *up*.
儿 ér ends in an upward hook on the right. 几 jǐ has a flat lid and turns down. 九 jiǔ crosses through itself.
水 shuǐ stands alone. 冰 bīng adds the two ice strokes 冫 on the left. 永 yǒng caps the same body with a dot.
车 chē is one vertical driven through two bars. 东 dōng hangs two dots under the crossbar.
All three live inside the gate 门. Look at what is standing in the doorway: 口 mouth (问 to ask), 日 sun (间 between), 耳 ear (闻 to hear).
All lean on the halberd 戈. 找 zhǎo is a hand 扌 reaching; 我 wǒ has the extra stroke slicing through the middle.
青 qīng on the right gives the sound; the left gives the sense — 讠 speech (请 please), 氵 water (清 clear), 忄 heart (情 feeling), 日 sun (晴 sunny), 目 eye (睛 eyeball).
Both are zuò. 做 zuò is three blocks wide (亻+ 古 + 攵) and means to make something. 作 zuò is just 亻+ 乍 and leans on doing or working.
在 zài tucks 土 (earth) under a slanted lid — being somewhere. 再 zài is a closed box with a bar driven through it — once more.
Same pair of legs below. 是 shì stands on 日 (sun); 足 zú stands on 口 (mouth).
友 yǒu is two hands, 𠂇 over 又. 右 yòu drops a 口 underneath instead. 有 yǒu carries a 月 (flesh) — to have.
卖 mài is 买 with a 十 on the roof — the seller has to put the goods *out*. Fewer strokes on top means you are buying.
Both take 昔 xī on the right. A person 亻 borrows (借 jiè); metal 钅 goes wrong (错 cuò).
Same 夬 on the right, three different left halves: heart 忄 is fast (快), earth 土 is a lump (块), ice 冫 decides (决).
Count the strokes on the right: 什 shén is 亻+ 十 (four total), 件 jiàn is 亻+ 牛 (six total).
All three are read tā. 他 for a man (亻), 她 for a woman (女), 它 for a thing — the only one under a roof 宀.
All are eyes 目. 睡 shuì adds 垂 (drooping) — eyelids falling; 睛 jīng adds 青; 眼 yǎn adds 艮; 眠 mián adds 民.
All ride the walking radical 辶. Only the passenger changes: 力 in 边 (side), 文 in 这 (this), 斤 in 近 (near), 元 in 远 (far), 寸 in 过 (to pass).
艮 on the right every time. The left half is the whole story: 彳 stepping (很 very), 木 wood (根 root), 足 foot (跟 heel), 目 eye (眼), 钅 metal (银 silver).
马 mǎ is the horse itself. Add a mouth 口 and it turns into the question particle 吗; add a woman 女 and it is 妈 mā, mother.
All built on 巴 bā. Mouth 口 makes the suggestion particle 吧; hand 扌 grabs (把); father 父 sits on top (爸); claws 爪 crawl (爬).
Same 耂 hat. 老 lǎo curls its last stroke into 匕; 考 kǎo ends in the hook 丂; 者 zhě puts a 日 underneath.
Same 曷 on the right. Drinking needs a mouth 口 (喝 hē); being thirsty is about the water 氵 you do not have (渴 kě).
Same 交 on the right. Wood 木 builds a school (校 xiào); a cart 车 does the comparing (较 jiào).
Same 佥 on the right. Wood 木 inspects (检 jiǎn); flesh 月 makes a face (脸 liǎn).
Four metals 钅 in a row. The right half is the entire difference: 戋 money, 㕣 lead pencil, 失 iron, 中 clock.
Both carry 方 fāng. 房 fáng shelters under a door 户; 放 fàng is being struck by 攵 — let go, release.
元 yuán is the seed. Boxed 囗 it is a garden (园), walking 辶 it is far (远), roofed 宀 it is finished (完), jade 王 makes it play (玩).
Identical right half. Silk 纟 is practice (练 liàn); fire 火 is smelting (炼 liàn). Same sound, same shape, different element.
夕 (evening) in three arrangements: 多 duō stacks 夕 on 夕; 名 míng puts 夕 over 口; 岁 suì puts 山 over 夕.
牛 niú slants its top stroke to the left; 午 wǔ lays it flat; 半 bàn adds two dots on top; 生 shēng adds one more crossbar.
方 fāng has a dot on the roof; 万 wàn does not. Nothing else separates them.
上 shàng grows *above* the baseline; 下 xià hangs *below* it; 卡 kǎ is both at once — stuck in between.
The two-stroke ice 冫 on the left of all four. Cold (冷), ice (冰), next (次), decide (决) — the right half carries every bit of the meaning.
主 zhǔ is the core. A person 亻 lives there (住), water 氵 pours (注), stepping 彳 heads toward (往).
哪 nǎ is 那 with a mouth 口 in front — you need a mouth to ask *which*.
Three water words. 汉 hàn takes 又 (a hand), 汗 hàn takes 干, 汽 qì takes 气 (vapour).
姓 xìng is 女 + 生 — a family name is born through the mother. 生 shēng alone is to be born.
All boxed in 囗. What is inside names it: 冬 a picture (图), 元 a garden (园), 玉 a country (国).
回 huí is a box inside a box. 四 sì has two little legs inside. 西 xī puts the same legs under a lid.
第 dì wears the bamboo hat ⺮ and orders things; 弟 dì is bare-headed and means younger brother.
Same box 囗. 因 yīn has 大 inside (cause), 回 huí another box (to return), 困 kùn a tree 木 (trapped, sleepy).
Both 票 and 要 stand on the lid 覀. 票 piào has 示 below; 要 yào has 女.
字 zì is 子 (child) given a roof 宀 — characters are what a child is taught under the family roof.
Both rest on a heart 心. 息 xī has 自 (the nose) above it — breathing; 思 sī has 田 (the skull) — thinking.
词 cí is 司 with 讠 (speech) in front. Without the speech radical it is 司 sī, to manage.
All wrap around 包 bāo. Food 饣 is full (饱), a hand 扌 hugs (抱), a foot 足 runs (跑), water 氵 bubbles (泡).
Both measure with an arrow 矢 on the left. 矮 ǎi ends in 委 (short in height); 短 duǎn ends in 豆 (short in length).
戈 with different left halves. 我 wǒ has the short slash crossing high; 找 zhǎo has the full hand 扌 with a hook.
One box, one stroke, four directions. 田 tián keeps it inside; 由 yóu pushes it out the top; 甲 jiǎ pushes it out the bottom; 申 shēn out both ends; 电 diàn bends the tail.
